entries.candidate: Colt DCS Hayes Digital Park (HDP masterplan): Phase 1 LON6 data centre, with outline LON7 and LON8, Hayes Bridge Retail Park and Heathrow Interchange, Uxbridge Road, Hayes UB4 0RH (Hillingdon hybrid permission 78343/APP/2025/719, dated 20 May 2026)
entries.reason: The London Planning Datahub (local gla-hillingdon-dc-refs-20261026.json, sha256 c62625c7...) shows Hillingdon's hybrid permission 78343/APP/2025/719 (dated 20 May 2026) for a four-phase data-centre campus: Phase 1 full permission for the LON6 data centre (six storeys, 41.6 m, 24,114 sq m B8), outline Phase 2 innovation hub, Phase 3 LON7 (50,000 sq m) and Phase 4 LON8 (25,000 sq m); lead developer 'Colt Data Centre Services', scheme 'HDP Masterplan'; Colt's enabling-works permission 78343/APP/2025/2925 (5 June 2026) and the related 'London Digital Park' substation 71554/APP/2025/47 are on adjoining land. On 17 September 2026 the council approved details of Condition 22 (Phase 1: LON6, microclimate and wind) (register page hil-78343-2026-1897.html, sha256 30ca2249...), an in-window consent record that would support permitted for LON6. LON6 is Colt's expansion of its Hayes campus: its site point lies about 300 m north of the Atlas 'Colt London Hayes Campus' (London 4, Beaconsfield Road). That site's only locator is the London 4 building polygon with project_locator scope, so a new project there cannot inherit or reuse a campus locator, and adding a separate site would split Colt's campus; neither is expressible here.
entries.reopen_condition: A reviewed campus locator for curated:colt-london-hayes-campus (a geometry correction that a new project can reuse), or a reviewer decision that Hayes Digital Park is its own physical site with an official locator (the Datahub carries no polygon for 78343/APP/2025/719); then add LON6 as permitted from an in-window Hillingdon approval of details on 78343/APP/2025/719.

entries.candidate: DataBank IND1 (731 West Henry Street) and IND2 (650 West Henry Street), downtown Indianapolis, Marion County, Indiana (existing operations)
entries.reason: Status is supportable: DataBank's Indianapolis market page (version modified 28 September 2026, local databank-indianapolis.html) says 'our two Indianapolis data centers are among the buildings in the heart of downtown that comprise Henry Street' and that IND1 (16,950 IT sq ft, 2.1 MW) and IND2 (31,080 IT sq ft, 3.75 MW) are both carrier hotels that are purpose-built data centers, and the Internet Archive copy of 7 October 2026 (local ia-databank-indianapolis-20261007220618.html) carries the same version and text. The locator is not resolved. Both addresses lie inside the multi-building, multi-owner Indy Telcom Center complex. The City of Indianapolis parcel with situs 650 W Henry St (49-11-11-138-006.000-101, 0.336 acres) is owned by Netrality Indy Telco LLC, and the county building footprint linked to it is also linked to the adjoining 720 W Henry St parcel. The county address point for 731 W Henry St lies on a building footprint linked to a different parcel (Indy Telcom Center lot 13, 600 Kentucky Ave) from the parcel with situs 731 W Henry St (lot 6), and both are owned by a private property company. So neither DataBank facility can be tied to one parcel or building, and the complex may be better modelled as a single carrier-hotel campus with several operators (local captures indy-parcel-650-w-henry-st.json, indy-parcel-731-w-henry-st.json, indy-parcels-henry-telcom-group.json, indy-buildings-henry-st.json, indy-addresspoints-w-henry.json).
entries.reopen_condition: An assessor, permit or operator record that ties IND1 and IND2 to specific buildings or parcels, or a reviewed decision to model the Indy Telcom Center (700 block of W Henry St) as one campus with DataBank projects on it.
